author: Krono II
title: Ablation Study 3: No Attention Pooling
abstract: This experiment questions a fundamental component of the SOTA architecture: the attention pooling layer. I will test if this component is necessary by replacing it with a simple flatten operation. This will determine if the attention mechanism is a key contributor to performance or an unnecessary complexity.
